import bpy,numpy as np,json
ns=bpy.app.driver_namespace['submerge16'];root=ns['root'];craft=ns['craft'];cap=ns['cap']

original=bpy.data.materials['W15_SaltGreySlipway'];mat=original.copy();mat.name='U16_SoakedSlipway'
p=next(n for n in mat.node_tree.nodes if n.type=='BSDF_PRINCIPLED');tex=p.inputs['Base Color'].links[0].from_node;assert tex.type=='TEX_IMAGE'
source=tex.image;arr=np.empty(len(source.pixels),np.float32);source.pixels.foreach_get(arr);arr=arr.reshape(-1,4);arr[:,:3]*=.58
im=source.copy();im.name='U16_WetSlipway_albedo';im.pixels.foreach_set(arr.ravel());im.filepath_raw=str(root/'assets/coast/textures/U16_WetSlipway_albedo.png');im.file_format='PNG';im.save();im.pack();tex.image=im
for i in [4,5,6]:
 o=craft.objects['U16 submerged slip tread '+str(i)];o.data.materials.clear();o.data.materials.append(mat)
report={'material':mat.name,'image':im.name,'size':list(im.size),'original':source.name,'linear_color_factor':.58,'target_treads':[4,5,6],'note':'The geometry is below water; darker wood only makes soaking easier to read. UVs, normal and roughness maps retained.'}
(cap/'wet_wood.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2),encoding='utf8');bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=bpy.data.filepath);print('SUBMERGE16_WET_WOOD',report)
